title: What to Look for in Receipt-Scanning Software
summary: Key features, evaluation criteria, and essential capabilities to consider when selecting a receipt-scanning and expense-tracking solution for a small team.
author: The SnapSME Team

sections.heading: Evaluating Receipt Scanning Solutions for Small Businesses
content: Receipt-scanning software has evolved significantly from slow desktop scanners to instant mobile apps. For small teams, choosing the right receipt-scanning tool can mean the difference between seamless adoption and employee frustration.
When evaluating receipt-scanning software for a team of 2 to 10 people, look beyond marketing promises and focus on these five core capabilities.

sections.heading: 1. Mobile-First Speed and Simplicity
content: If an app takes more than 10 seconds to open, snap a photo, and save a receipt, team members won't use it consistently. The user interface must be clean, fast, and mobile-optimized so expenses can be captured on the go.

sections.heading: 2. High Accuracy Optical Character Recognition (OCR)
content: The core technology of any receipt scanner is its OCR engine. High-quality OCR automatically extracts merchant name, date, total amount, currency, and suggested category from a photo — requiring minimal manual corrections from the user.
sections.callout: Test an app with crumpled or dimly lit paper receipts to verify how well its OCR engine performs under real-world conditions.

sections.heading: 3. Multi-Modal Capture Options (Photo, Voice, & Documents)
content: Not all expenses come in the form of a paper receipt. Excellent receipt-scanning tools offer flexible multi-modal capture options:
Photo capture for paper receipts, document upload for digital PDF invoices, and voice note recording for cash purchases where no paper receipt is available.
bullets: Camera receipt photo capture with client-side image compression.
PDF and DOCX document file attachment support.
Voice-to-text recording for quick verbal expense logging.

sections.heading: 4. Multi-Currency Conversion Support
content: If your business buys software online or travels internationally, expenses will arrive in different currencies. Look for software that automatically converts original transaction amounts into your default accounting currency using live exchange rates.

sections.heading: 5. Transparent, Predictable Pricing
content: Many enterprise expense platforms charge complex per-user monthly fees that quickly add up for small teams. Look for simple, transparent software built specifically for small businesses — or free-to-use platforms like SnapSME.
